# 41st Lucille Lortel Awards

| venue = Skirball Center for Performing Arts
}}
The 41st Lucille Lortel Awards will be held on May 3, 2026, recognizing excellence in Off-Broadway productions during the 2025-26 season. Nominations were announced on April 1, 2026, with Mexodus receiving the most nominations with nine, followed by Prince Faggot with six. The Lortel Awards are jointly produced by the Off-Broadway League and the Lucille Lortel Theatre, with support from Theatre Development Fund.
Nominees
The 2025-2026 Lucille Lortel Awards nominations were announced on April 1, 2025 by Amber Gray and Harvey Guillén. Mexodus was the most nominated musical and production, receiving nine nominations, with Prince Faggot leading the plays with six nominations.
Winners will be announced at the awards ceremony, to be held at the Skirball Center for Performing Arts on May 3, 2026.
